style_concept: Torn meets D&D Dark Fantasy. Pixel Art aesthetics wrapped in a modern, gritty web UI. Aged parchment textures, blocky retro typography mixed with serif narrative text, and a highly structured high-density grid system.

heading.usage: H1, H2, Primary Actions, Nav Links
heading.description: A crisp, legible pixel font that evokes old-school RPGs and terminal displays.

body.usage: Stats, Inventory Tooltips, UI Data, Tables
body.description: Clean monospace for readable data and stats.

narrative.usage: Combat log, Lore text, Quest descriptions
narrative.description: A classic D&D parchment feel for storytelling text.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.h3: text-xl md:text-2xl tracking-normal uppercase font-heading text-amber-500

colors.css_variables_instructions: Convert these to HSL in index.css (e.g., --background: 30 15% 4%; --primary: 46 65% 52%;). Map Shadcn variables directly to these to override the default look.

visual_enhancers.borders: Strictly 1px solid borders. Do not use rounded corners. Everything must be `rounded-none` to fit the retro/pixel aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard box shadows. No soft blurs. Example: `shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)]`. For glowing elements, use a hard outline + a subtle colored shadow.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain overlay on the main background. Use a pseudo-element with a noise base64 PNG or CSS radial gradients to mimic dark parchment.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use `lucide-react` but configure them with `strokeWidth={1.5}` and square wrappers to mimic pixel bounds.
visual_enhancers.placeholders: For pixel sprites (32x32 / 64x64), use a checkerboard or dark grid background (`bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,...')]`) with a 1px border. Never use generic image placeholders.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-heading text-xl uppercase border-2 border-primary hover:bg-black hover:text-primary transition-colors px-6 py-2 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#7A1B1B]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-primary font-heading text-xl uppercase border-2 border-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-black transition-colors px-6 py-2
buttons.ghost: text-slate-400 hover:text-primary font-body uppercase text-sm tracking-widest
buttons.action_rules: Always include an active/pressed state that translates the button down (`active:translate-y-[2px] active:shadow-none`).

cards.lore_card: bg-panel border border-border p-6 shadow-lg hover:border-primary transition-all duration-300 relative
cards.inventory_slot: w-16 h-16 bg-surface border border-border flex items-center justify-center relative group cursor-pointer hover:bg-panel

HUD.hp_bar: h-4 bg-void border border-border w-full relative. Inside: a `bg-blood` div representing HP percentage. Include absolute centered text for numerical value in `font-body text-xs`.
HUD.stats_panel: Grid layout showing Vitality, Cognition, Essence, Drive. Use monospace numbers, right-aligned for columns.

dice.wrapper: w-24 h-24 border-2 border-primary bg-black flex items-center justify-center text-5xl font-heading text-primary relative
dice.animation: When rolling, use a stepped animation (not smooth). `animation: dice-roll 0.5s steps(6) forwards`. After roll, expand shadow and flash border color based on outcome (Crit Fail = Red, Crit Success = Gold).

dialog.shadcn_override: Override Radix Dialog. Use `bg-panel`, `border-2 border-primary`, `rounded-none`. The overlay should be a dense `bg-black/80` (no blur to keep it gritty).

marketing.pattern: Bento Grid (TETRIS mode) or single-column cinematic scroll.
marketing.spacing: Massive vertical spacing (`gap-24`, `py-32`) to let the dark lore text breathe.

character_creation.pattern: Stepped wizard. Split screen: Left side showing selected lore/portrait with heavy borders, Right side showing selection options (Grid of races/roles).
character_creation.spacing: Dense option grids (`gap-4`) but generous padding around the main container (`p-8`).

game_hud.pattern: Three-column structural grid (Side-Center-Side). Left: Player Status & Stats. Center: Narrative stream & Combat Actions. Right: World Events, Daily Missions, Mini-map.
game_hud.spacing: Very dense (`gap-1` or `gap-0` with borders collapsing). Reminiscent of a command terminal or old MUD interface.

motion.general: Keep it snappy. Avoid long ease-in-out floats. Prefer `steps()` timing functions for a frame-by-frame pixel feel.
motion.narrative_text: Use a staggered typewriter reveal effect (`framer-motion` staggerChildren) for combat outcomes and lore delivery.
motion.dice_roll: Dramatic pause. Click -> Dice shakes rapidly for 0.8s -> Stops instantly on number -> Screen flash (subtle opacity 0.1) -> Typewriter text reveals outcome.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA. Ensure text on `#2A241F` is at least `#D3CDBF`.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Every button, input, inventory slot, and narrative choice must have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="race-select-orc"`).

image_urls.description: Dark atmospheric misty forest/landscape for hero background. Apply a strong black/amber gradient overlay.
Aged paper/parchment texture to be used as a blending layer over the map section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a gritty, text-heavy dark fantasy RPG with pixel aesthetics.
DO NOT use Inter or standard sans-serif for headings. Use VT323 for all H1/H2/Buttons.
DO NOT use `rounded-md` or `rounded-lg`. Set standard border-radius to 0 globally.
For the dice mechanic, build a dedicated component that handles a 1-6 randomizer with a CSS stepped animation and color-codes the outcome text.
For inventory items, apply rarity colors purely as border colors on the item slot (`border-b-4 border-[rarity-color]`).
In the Game HUD, ensure the layout spans the full height (`h-screen`) and prevents global scrolling; only internal panels (like narrative or inventory) should scroll.
Do NOT use generic emojis. Rely entirely on typography, color, and sharp borders to communicate UI state.
Include JWT Auth structure and define the mock API flows for character creation and dice rolls.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER create generic centered layouts with smooth gradients.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for marketing pages, but for the Game HUD, use extreme density (Bento/Terminal style).
Add `transition-transform duration-75` for interactive buttons to simulate instant button presses rather than slow fades.
Ensure all Shadcn UI components (Forms, Dialogs) are stripped of their default rounded borders and soft shadows, replacing them with hard borders and brutalist styling.
